status.en: 8 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 60% fewer than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 8 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 60 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Syria is confirming the deployment of troops to Saudi Arabia to support the Saudi war against the Houthis while simultaneously denying any presence in Yemen. Syrian security forces have killed the leader of an armed cell in Tartus. The interior minister is meeting residents in the Damascus countryside to discuss security challenges. Japan lawmakers are proposing to extend SDF personnel service to age 65. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syria bekrefter utplassering av tropper til Saudi-Arabia for å støtte den saudiske krigen mot houthiene, samtidig som de benekter enhver tilstedeværelse i Jemen. Syriske sikkerhetsstyrker har drept lederen av en bevæpnet celle i Tartus. Innenriksministeren møter innbyggere på landsbygda utenfor Damaskus for å diskutere sikkerhetsutfordringer. Japanske lovgivere foreslår å forlenge tjenestetiden for SDF-personell til 65 år. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
